🪙 Node2Mint — AI Sell Modern

Self-hosted AI marketplace, token billing engine, and OpenAI-compatible API gateway with atomic ledger balances, provider failover, and affiliate distribution.

A production-ready full-stack platform built with Next.js 15, Go 1.22, PostgreSQL 16, Redis 7, and Caddy 2 for selling digital products, token packs, and routing AI model access.

Why Node2Mint · Features · Architecture · Quick Start · API Reference · Configuration · Deployment · Security · Bahasa Indonesia

--- ## ⚡ Why Node2Mint? Running an AI model reselling service or token marketplace requires strict ledger safety. Distributed billing systems frequently suffer from race conditions, double-spending, and upstream provider outages. **Node2Mint** solves these engineering challenges by combining a high-concurrency **Go 1.22 API gateway** with an **atomic PostgreSQL 16 transaction model**: * 🔒 **Atomic Money & Token Balances:** All balance debits and credits use row-level database locking (`SELECT FOR UPDATE`) within strict transaction boundaries—eliminating negative-balance race conditions. * 🔄 **Automated Provider Failover:** Outbound AI chat completions automatically route through active upstream providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, custom endpoints) with health checks and circuit breaker fallback. * 🔑 **Hashed Credentials (Zero Plaintext):** User API keys are stored exclusively as `SHA-256` hashes. Full keys are displayed only once upon creation and never stored in plaintext. * 💳 **Multi-Channel Global & Local Payments:** Native support for card/e-wallet gateways (**Stripe, DOKU**), manual **QRIS / Bank Transfers** with admin verification workflows, and optional **TRC-20 USDT** crypto settlement. * 🚀 **Built-In Growth & Affiliate Engine:** Native referral system (bonus token grants for inviters and invitees) and automated affiliate wallet commissions on completed marketplace orders. * 🖥️ **50+ Production Web Templates Included:** Complete responsive UI across customer marketplace, seller dashboard, interactive AI playground/chat, and administrative consoles. ### How Node2Mint Compares (LLM Gateway & Marketplace Matrix) | Capability | **Node2Mint** | LiteLLM / One-API | OpenRouter (Cloud) | | :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: | | **OpenAI-Compatible Gateway (`/v1/chat/completions`)** | ✅ Yes | ✅ Yes | ✅ Yes | | **Upstream Health Checks & Circuit Breaker Failover** | ✅ Yes | ✅ Yes | ✅ Yes | | **Row-Locked Atomic Ledger (`SELECT FOR UPDATE`)** | ✅ **Yes** | ⚠️ Varies | ✅ Yes | | **Multi-Vendor Digital Marketplace & Escrow Wallet** | ✅ **Yes (Built-in)** | ❌ No | ❌ No | | **Affiliate Commission & Referral Quota Engine** | ✅ **Yes (Built-in)** | ❌ No | ❌ No | | **Stripe, DOKU, QRIS & TRC-20 USDT Payments** | ✅ **Yes (Native)** | ❌ External Plugin | ❌ Stripe/Crypto Only | | **100% Self-Hosted & Full Source Ownership** | ✅ **MIT License** | ✅ Open Source | ❌ Proprietary SaaS | --- ## 🧩 Features & Core Modules

🔀 API Gateway & Token Billing

  • OpenAI-Compatible /v1/chat/completions: Serves upstream models to client apps, SDKs, Cursor, and Cline using standardized schema headers.
  • Dynamic Token Metering: Deducts user balances based on exact model input/output rates, including cached prompt discount calculations.
  • Fixed-Window Rate Limiting: Per-IP and per-account request throttling enforced via Redis 7.
  • Telegram Notification Gateway: Real-time alerts via Telegram Bot API for order placements, dispute escalations, and group membership verification.

🛒 Marketplace & Escrow Commerce

  • Storefront & Product Catalog: Sell digital prompts, fine-tuned models, datasets, software tools, and subscription access packs.
  • Escrow Settlement: Buyer funds are safely held in platform escrow until manual or automated confirmation releases payout to the seller's store wallet.
  • Order Cancellation & Refunds: Safe rollback paths with immutable, atomic transaction log entries for every money movement.
  • Seller Store Management: Product publishing, GMV/sales analytics, dispute handling, and withdrawal requests.

🤝 Affiliate & Referral Program

  • Referral Rewards: Automatic token quota grants for new signups and referral code owners.
  • Affiliate Commission: Configurable percentage payouts deposited directly into affiliator wallets upon order settlement.
  • Anti-Fraud Controls: IP hashing, Cloudflare Turnstile, and duplicate signup checks protect referral distributions.

🎨 Frontend & UI/UX (Next.js 15)

  • Dual-Mode Shell: Customer portal with sleek dark-mode aesthetics paired with a high-contrast amber administrative shell.
  • Multilingual (i18n): Built-in English (`en`) and Bahasa Indonesia (`id`) localization dictionaries.
  • Client-Side Image Optimization: Browser canvas WebP image compression (<256 KB) prior to server upload.
--- ## 🏗️ System Architecture ```text Client (Web / Mobile / CLI / OpenAI SDK) │ ▼ Caddy 2 Reverse Proxy (HTTPS / TLS Termination) ┌──────────┴──────────┐ ▼ ▼ Next.js 15 Frontend Go API Gateway (Port 3000 / SSR) (Port 8080 / REST) │ ┌─────────────────────────┼─────────────────────────┐ ▼ ▼ ▼ PostgreSQL 16 Redis 7 Upstream AI APIs (Ledger / Orders / Auth) (Rate Limiting) (OpenAI / Anthropic / Custom) ``` ### Directory Structure ```text node2mint/ ├── gateway/ # Go backend gateway (Chi router, pgxpool, redis) │ ├── cmd/gateway/ # Application entrypoint │ ├── internal/ │ │ ├── auth/ # JWT Bearer tokens, password hashing │ │ ├── billing/ # Atomic charges, balance validation │ │ ├── handler/ # HTTP controllers (admin, market, tokens, chat) │ │ ├── provider/ # Upstream AI model client & failover │ │ ├── rate/ # Redis-backed fixed-window rate limiter │ │ └── store/ # PostgreSQL queries and migrations │ ├── sql/ # Schema definitions and base seed │ └── .env.example # Backend environment template ├── web/ # Next.js 15 frontend (Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui) │ ├── app/ # App router (marketplace, dashboard, admin, auth) │ ├── components/ # Reusable UI components & layout shells │ ├── lib/ # API clients, auth context, i18n dictionaries │ └── .env.example # Frontend environment template ├── deploy/ # Production deployment configurations │ ├── docker-compose.prod.yml │ ├── Caddyfile │ └── site-allowlist.env.example ├── docs/ # Design system and architecture documentation ├── docker-compose.yml # Development stack orchestration └── smoke-test.sh # End-to-end billing and order regression check ``` --- ## 🚀 Quick Start ### 1. Prerequisites * **Docker Engine** & **Docker Compose v2+** * **Go 1.22+** (for local backend development) * **Node.js 18+** (for local frontend development) ### 2. Clone the Repository ```bash git clone [https://github.com/yanstd888/node2mint.git](https://github.com/yanstd888/node2mint.git) cd node2mint ``` ### 3. Configure Environments ```bash cp gateway/.env.example gateway/.env cp web/.env.example web/.env.local cp -r gateway/.secrets.example gateway/.secrets ``` > 💡 *The example templates contain pre-configured dev credentials. For production, generate unique 32+ character secrets (`JWT_SECRET`, `SECRET_KEY`).* ### 4. Run Development Stack Start backend services (PostgreSQL 16, Redis 7, Go Gateway, Uptime Kuma): ```bash docker compose up -d --build ``` Verify all containers are healthy: ```bash docker compose ps curl http://localhost:8080/healthz # Returns "ok" ``` Start Next.js 15 frontend (in a separate terminal): ```bash cd web npm install npm run dev ``` Access the local services: * 🌐 **Web Marketplace & App:** `http://localhost:3000` * ⚡ **API Gateway:** `http://localhost:8080` * 📊 **Uptime Kuma Health Dashboard:** `http://localhost:3001` #### Default Seed Accounts (Local Development Only) The local compose setup automatically mounts `gateway/sql/99-local-dev-seed.sql` with two test accounts: | Role | Email | Password | Pre-seeded Balance | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **Admin** | `admin@test.local` | `Test1234!` | `50,000 IDR` | | **Seller** | `seller@test.local` | `Test1234!` | `10,000 IDR` (Demo Store with 13 products) | *(Seed accounts are strictly excluded in production deployments).* ### 5. Automated End-to-End Verification Run the money and order validation regression smoke test: ```bash bash smoke-test.sh ``` --- ## 🔌 API Reference The Go gateway exposes REST endpoints alongside OpenAI-compatible completions: | Method | Endpoint | Auth | Description | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `POST` | `/v1/chat/completions` | Bearer API Key | OpenAI-compatible chat completions with failover | | `POST` | `/api/auth/register` | Public / Turnstile | User registration with signup token grants | | `POST` | `/api/auth/login` | Public / Turnstile | User authentication returning JWT token | | `GET` | `/api/dashboard` | JWT | User profile, quotas, and wallet balance | | `GET` | `/api/keys` | JWT | List active API keys (prefix only) | | `POST` | `/api/keys` | JWT | Generate new API key (raw secret shown once) | | `DELETE` | `/api/keys/{id}` | JWT | Revoke existing API key | | `GET` | `/api/market/products` | Public | List published digital goods and access packs | | `POST` | `/api/market/orders` | JWT | Place marketplace order with atomic balance escrow | | `POST` | `/api/market/orders/{id}/confirm` | JWT | Buyer release of escrow to seller store wallet | | `GET` | `/api/packages` | Public | Available token top-up and signup packages | | `POST` | `/api/payment/checkout` | JWT | Create payment invoice (Stripe, DOKU, QRIS) | | `GET` | `/api/admin/summary` | Admin | High-level platform GMV and user analytics | | `POST` | `/api/admin/withdrawal/{id}/decide` | Admin | Approve or reject seller withdrawal with audit log | --- ## ⚙️ Configuration Neutral configuration templates are provided in `.env.example` files. **Never commit `.env` or `.env.local` files to version control.** ### Gateway (`gateway/.env`) | Variable | Description | Default | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `DATABASE_URL` | PostgreSQL connection string | `postgresql://aiuser:***@localhost:5432/aisell` | | `REDIS_ADDR` | Redis host and port | `localhost:6379` | | `JWT_SECRET` | 32+ character random string for auth tokens | `CHANGE_ME_RANDOM_SECRET` | | `SECRET_KEY` | 32+ character random string for data encryption | `CHANGE_ME_ENCRYPTION_KEY` | | `PORT` | HTTP listener port | `8080` | | `RATE_LIMIT_DISABLE` | Disable rate limiter (local dev only) | `false` | | `STRIPE_SECRET_KEY` | Optional Stripe API secret key | *(empty)* | | `DOKU_SANDBOX` | Toggle DOKU payment simulator | `true` | | `TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN` | Optional bot token for group membership gate | *(empty)* | ### Frontend (`web/.env.local`) | Variable | Description | Default | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL` | Gateway API URL | `http://localhost:8080` | | `NEXT_PUBLIC_DEFAULT_LOCALE` | Default language (`id` or `en`) | `id` | | `NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_NAME` | Branding title | `Node2Mint` | --- ## 🚢 Deployment ### Docker Compose (Production) For production environments, mount secrets via Docker secrets or protected environment files: ```bash cd deploy cp site-allowlist.env.example site-allowlist.env docker compose --env-file site-allowlist.env -f docker-compose.prod.yml up -d ``` ### Cloudflare Tunnel Setup To expose Node2Mint securely without opening public inbound firewall ports: ```bash cloudflared tunnel run --protocol http2 --token YOUR_CLOUDFLARE_TUNNEL_TOKEN ``` --- ## 🛡️ Safety and Security * **Zero Plaintext Secrets in Repository:** No production keys, database passwords, or operational secrets are stored in Git. * **Hashed API Keys:** Gateway API keys are hashed with `SHA-256` before insertion. Only the prefix (e.g., `n2m_live_...`) is queryable by users. * **Race Condition Prevention:** Balances, order stock, and withdrawal flows run in isolated transactions with `SELECT ... FOR UPDATE` row locks. * **Bot & Abuse Mitigation:** Optional Cloudflare Turnstile verification guards public registration and authentication endpoints. * **Structured Audit Logs:** Every administrative balance adjustment, top-up approval, escrow release, and withdrawal records an immutable audit log row with actor ID, IP address, and timestamp. ### Pre-Commit & CI Verification Run local checks before staging any pull request: ```bash # Go gateway verification cd gateway go vet ./... go test ./... # Frontend type checking and build cd ../web npx tsc --noEmit --pretty false npm run build # Git cleanliness check git diff --check ``` --- ## 🇮🇩 Bahasa Indonesia — Ringkasan Node2Mint **Node2Mint** adalah platform *full-stack open-source* (**Next.js 15 + Go 1.22 + PostgreSQL 16 + Redis 7**) yang menggabungkan **Marketplace Produk Digital AI**, **Token Billing Engine**, dan **OpenAI-Compatible API Gateway**. Dirancang khusus untuk menjawab kebutuhan ekosistem bisnis digital modern (baik global maupun Indonesia): * **Keamanan Saldo Anti-Minus (Atomic Ledger):** Menggunakan *row-level locking* (`SELECT FOR UPDATE`) di PostgreSQL untuk mencegah *race condition* atau *double-spending* saat ribuan request API berjalan bersamaan. * **Dukungan Pembayaran Lokal & Global:** Mendukung integrasi **DOKU, QRIS, Transfer Bank Manual**, **Stripe**, hingga **USDT (TRC-20)** serta sistem rekber (*Escrow*) otomatis untuk melindungi pembeli dan penjual di marketplace. * **Kompatibel Penuh dengan Ekosistem OpenAI:** Endpoint `/v1/chat/completions` dilengkapi *automatic provider failover* dan *circuit breaker*, siap dihubungkan ke aplikasi AI, bot, maupun IDE seperti Cursor dan Cline. --- ## 📚 Documentation & Ecosystem | Document / Resource | Purpose | | :--- | :--- | | [**LICENSE**](LICENSE) | MIT Open Source License terms | | [**CONTRIBUTING.md**](CONTRIBUTING.md) | Branching guidelines, coding standards, and PR workflows | | [**SECURITY.md**](SECURITY.md) | Vulnerability disclosure policy and reporting contacts | | [**CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md**](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) | Contributor Covenant v2.1 community standards | | [**Design System**](docs/DESIGN-SYSTEM.md) | Frontend component specs, color palette, and layout rules | | [**AICLUB Indonesia (`aiclub.ai.id`)**](https://aiclub.ai.id/) | Official AI tools directory, free `.ai.id` subdomains, and community hub | | [**Toko AICLUB (`toko.aiclub.ai.id`)**](https://toko.aiclub.ai.id) | Live digital product & application marketplace | --- ## 🤝 Contributing & License Contributions, bug reports, and pull requests are welcome!
